title: header map created in pinfo->pool before the start line and saved into the conversation's file-scope data
live_proof: absent at the 4.6.8 pin by inspection: packet-http.c creates header_value_map only from wmem_file_scope() (:1598) before storing it at :1777/:1782; the stray-header path that creates the map in pinfo->pool (3a5f82dfb5^ at :1808-1814) does not exist at the pin, so the store cannot carry a packet-scope map there. The pre-fix shape is quoted from 3a5f82dfb5^ at packet-http.c:1808-1814 (the pinfo->pool map), :1781/:1786 (the store), :1797-1804 (the retrieval) and :3611 with wmem_map.c:299 (the insert's first read).
object: the wmem_map_t header map, 88 bytes in pinfo->pool
lifetime_ender: epan_dissect_reset between packets (epan.c:625 at the fix's parent); the conversation's private data keeps the map pointer
shape: packet-scope object kept by file-scope state across packets
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator; the map is reduced to its struct storage and the insert to its first read of the struct
distinguishing: the stale access is the allocator's own metadata read inside wmem_map_insert; had it not faulted, the next step would call the allocator through the stale map's data_allocator. Reoccupation is asserted before the marker because the report's allocator log shows another dissector's allocation sitting in the freed block
